Everything found is inside the guided Q4-2026 NDA timeline the pre-NDA meeting already confirmed, and this name's prints barely move (median 4.2%); the mild positive is a benign regulatory line into 13% short and a call-heavy book 6% above the low.

Small, because the quarter itself is a modest beat into a 17-20% short at negative enterprise value and this name's prints have moved a median 4%.

The category leader is cutting its effective pouch price ~25% and guiding to abnormally low US Q4 profitability as TPB enters chain resets, and the company itself declined to lift Modern Oral with nine days of Q3 left while cutting EBITDA - yet the stock rallied 20% in October into a new CEO's first call. Offset by 16.7% short at 6.7 days and six up-prints in eight.

Two peers printed the same quarter on 5 and 6 November, after VFF last spoke in August - Aurora international medical a record +44%, Canopy international +141%, both on Germany and Poland - into a three-analyst bar that sits flat on Q2 and has under-modelled revenue by 13-15% on each of the last three prints, every one of which was bought (+13.9%, +16.9%, +34.3%). Sized down for the 16% five-day run and Aurora's margin compression.

A beat and a fourth FY raise are likely and this name does not pay for them (-7.5% and -16.6% on its two biggest guide beats), and item 1 is arithmetic nobody has done publicly: YTD EBITDA plus the Q3 guide midpoint is already through the low end of the FY range, so the first-ever positive Q4 needs a $4-8M swing, into a stock at its consensus price target after a 75% run.
